description: Response returned after successfully creating a new OAuth client.

clientSecret.description: The OAuth client secret (only returned on creation). This is the secret string known only to the client and the authorization server, used for authenticating the client. See https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7591#section-2.2

clientSecretExpiresAt.description: An integer indicating the expiration time of the client secret, represented as the number of seconds since the Unix epoch (1970-01-01T00:00:00Z). A value of 0 indicates that the secret does not expire. See https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7591#section-2.2
